title: UNI MCP response envelope
description: Every response from the UNI production MCP (production/mcp/server.py) and the future uni-public-mcp (SPEC_uni_public_mcp.md) wraps its result in this envelope. Extracted verbatim from production/mcp/server.py:91-118 metadata() so that inline behaviour is preserved while consumers get a versioned contract.

server.description: The MCP server that answered: uni-production-mcp | uni-public-mcp | uni-control-mcp.

git_commit.description: HEAD SHA of the running server's code. Null if the server was booted from a source tree that is not under git.

docs.description: Free-form pointer to uni:// resources or docs/UNIVERSE.md sections.

help.description: Optional short primer / this-tool summary / more pointer. Present on human-usable responses; may be omitted on machine-consumed ones.

result.description: Tool-specific payload. Shape defined by the tool's own contract; the envelope makes no claim about its schema.

refused.description: Present + true when the router refused a mutation with an evidence-attached rejection (per D-C2). result.reason MUST explain why.
